name: Ináncs (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ináncs: a crowned red and blue shield with white bars and a book, supported by a yellow lion and a horse, above a scroll inscribed INÁNCS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
